title: 第1348章 惊走强敌第1347章 气死我了
content_zh:
不过本着信任吉恩的话，他还是采取了稳重点的办法。
毕竟不管这域外天魔，来历有多强大，有多了不起，祂都要遵循大千世界的规则，能量消耗到一定的量后，就会被三维空间，排斥出次空间！
而且祂在下界的能量，是使用一点就愈少一点。
所以只要继续下去，对方迟早要败的。
“来吧！两个蝼蚁！让你们见识下，什么才是力量！”松剑笑着说道。
在两人对话的短暂时间内，松剑的身外法身已然成形。
其实吉恩的伏龙诀，也不是没有任何效果，起码将松剑的力量，削减了一丢丢，毕竟他的功法摆在这里！
几百年前，暗赢被守护者联盟召唤到蓝星，因为守护者联盟召唤法阵通道大小问题，再加上经验使然，暗赢投入的神魂也不多，结果直接被吉恩，用天阳决与探索者机甲压着打！
这次松剑投入的神魂比较多，所以吉恩根本拿不下。
大地震动，原本高温硫化后还散发着余温的地面，再次被松剑践踏的碎裂开来。
说着这个身高七十多米的巨型松剑，迈开双腿噔噔，几步走到吉恩与力嗷身前，几平米大小的拳头捣向了两人。
“这样？”力嗷问道。
只见松剑保持出拳的姿势，但拳头并没有捣到底，祂的拳头被力嗷用一只手给抵住了！
除了一开始，刚刚被被传送过来，没有做好准备，被松剑击飞了，如今力嗷有所准备，他想这三维空间内，应该没有人有力气比自己大吧？
那些真正的大佬除外。
“……”松剑内心一阵草泥马跑过。
感受手臂上传来的刺痛之感，祂感觉对方的手臂，都刺到自己拳头内了，这两人到底是哪里来的怪物？
问题是就这样，自己得拳头纹丝不动！
咚！
“啊！喝！”松剑喝道。

松剑将另一只手合拢成拳，用力捶在被力嗷托住的拳头上，
两拳相撞，发出沉闷的撞击声，然后祂引以为傲的身外法身，拳头上好像真的被撕破了！
“话说你的拳头，不如你的嗓门大！”力嗷嘲讽道。
其实他能抗住松剑的拳头，不是他的力量有多大，而是安保机器人自身携带的力量使然，因为权限太低，他的灵气无法全额使用。
但他可以驾驶机甲，使用宇宙之中无处不在的引力，可以说只要他愿意，松剑等于在和整个宇宙角力！
所以安保机甲不仅没有下沉，反而和地面维持了一丝绝对距离。
“虚弱！”松剑喝道。
松剑气的不行，提起手臂直起腰来，直接开口施展了一个神术，只见几道金色流光，从松剑口中喷出，直奔力嗷。
可惜遇到遇到力嗷后，被安保机器的机体，给阻挡在外面，这道金色流光还不满意，缠在安保机器上的机体上，不停的流转，想要寻找突破口。
“如果你只有这点力量，那就不好意思啦。”力嗷语气轻松的说道。
力嗷控制着机器人，适应了这股巨力后，直接用力一撞。
感受着神术带来的力量，并无法完全限制自己，力嗷自然要给对方长长记性。
咚～
咚～
……
轰隆～
大地再次传来震动。
content_en:
However, out of trust in Jean's words, he still adopted a prudent approach.
After all, no matter how powerful or amazing this extraterrestrial devil is, he must follow the rules of the world. After a certain amount of energy is consumed, he will be expelled from the three-dimensional space and out of the sub-space!
Moreover, His energy in the lower realm is used less and less.
So as long as you continue, the opponent will lose sooner or later.
"Come on! Two ants! Let me show you what power is!" Song Jian said with a smile.
During the short period of conversation between the two, Song Jian's outer body had already taken shape.
In fact, Jean's Fu Long Technique is not without any effect. At least it reduces the power of Song Jian a little bit. After all, his technique is here!
Hundreds of years ago, An Ying was summoned to Blue Star by the Guardian Alliance. Due to the size of the summoning array channel of the Guardian Alliance, and due to experience, An Ying did not invest much soul. As a result, he was directly suppressed and beaten by Jean using Tianyang Jue and Explorer mecha!
Song Jian invested more souls this time, so Jean couldn't take it at all.
The earth shook, and the ground that was still exuding residual warmth after high-temperature vulcanization was once again broken into pieces by the Song Sword's trampling.
As he spoke, the giant Songjian, who was more than seventy meters tall, opened his legs and walked in front of Jean and Li Ao in a few steps. He punched the two of them with a fist that was several square meters in size.
"Is this so?" Li Ao asked.
I saw Song Jian maintaining his punching posture, but his fist did not hit the bottom. His fist was blocked by Li Ao with one hand!
Except at the beginning, when he was just teleported, he was unprepared and was knocked away by the loose sword. Now that Li Ao was prepared, he thought that no one in this three-dimensional space should be stronger than him, right?
Except for the real big guys.
"..." There was a rush of grass and mud horses running through Song Jian's heart.
Feeling the tingling sensation on his arm, he felt that the other person's arm was piercing his fist. Where did these two monsters come from?
The problem is that just like this, I have to keep my fists motionless!
Boom!
"Ah! Drink!" Song Jian shouted.
Song Jian closed his other hand into a fist and punched the fist held by Li Ao.
The two fists collided with each other, making a dull impact, and then the body of the Dharma Body that he was so proud of seemed to be really torn on his fists!
"Speaking of which, your fists are not as loud as your voice!" Li Ao mocked.
In fact, the reason why he was able to withstand Song Jian's fist was not because of his strength, but because of the power carried by the security robot itself. Because the authority was too low, his aura could not be used in full.
But he can drive a mecha and use the ubiquitous gravity in the universe. It can be said that as long as he is willing, Song Jian is wrestling with the entire universe!
Therefore, not only did the security mecha not sink, but it maintained an absolute distance from the ground.
"Weak!" Song Jian shouted.
Song Jian was so angry that he raised his arms, straightened his waist, and directly opened his mouth to perform a magical technique. Several golden streams of light were ejected from Song Jian's mouth and went straight to Li Ao.
It's a pity that after encountering Li Ao, it was blocked by the body of the security machine. This golden stream of light was not satisfied yet. It wrapped around the body of the security machine and kept flowing, trying to find a breakthrough.
"It would be a shame if you only had this little power." Li Ao said in a relaxed tone.
Li Ao controlled the robot, and after adapting to the huge force, he hit it hard.
Feeling the power brought by divine magic, you can't completely limit yourself. Naturally, you have to give the opponent a long memory.
Boom~
Boom~
…
Boom ~
The ground shook again.
